descriptions.d33b_item_info_80099dc0: Builds the item info page: writes the title lines from the table 0x803f4bd0, formats the item count and offset, prints name, description and both numbers, reads the selected text entry into a string through a text stream, splits it at newlines into a vector of strings, strips each up to its last backslash and from any plus sign, prints each 'label:value' row (first five in colour 9, the rest in colour 7), adds the options footer, writes the page to the sink and sets the state +40 to 3 and the mode +36 to 0.
